item.description: - Weekly plan limits now show today's share: what was left at midnight, spread over the days until the reset, so you can see how much you can use today and still last the week. On the Usage tab the bar draws today's use lighter, with a tick where today's share ends, and the line under it reads like "Today 6% of about 21%". The History page says the same under each weekly chart. 5-hour limits are unchanged. - A new notification, off by default (Settings → Notifications → Today's share of weekly limits), tells you once a day when a weekly limit has used today's share, so you can ease off early. Going on is fine; tomorrow's share is just smaller. - `dashbar status` adds today's share to weekly limits, and `dashbar status --json` has `todayShare` and `usedToday` for them. The dashbar-status skill tells agents to mention it before heavy work.

- Plan limits on the Usage tab and the History page now count down with the clock. Before, a limit whose reading stayed at the same percent for hours kept showing an old "resets in" time and pace line until its reading changed. Thanks to Sally Hong for the detailed report.

- A new keyboard shortcut jumps to the agent that needs you: it brings forward the app of the session that has waited longest for you, or, if none is waiting, the one that finished last. Set it in Settings → General (there's none until you pick one). Tools switched off in Show in Dashbar are skipped. - Settings → About has Copy Diagnostics: a short summary for a bug report (Dashbar's and macOS's versions, which tools and integrations Dashbar found, any format warnings, the widgets' state, how many extra accounts and where Claude's plan limits come from). It never includes project names, folders, sessions or account names, Show Diagnostics lets you read it before you copy, and nothing is sent.
